pages.about: Willow & Wax stocks candles, home fragrance and everyday essentials for the modern home. We ship quickly, we price fairly, and we are steadily widening the range in response to what our customers ask for.
pages.refund_policy: Unopened items may be returned within 14 days of delivery. Consumable items cannot be returned once opened. Refunds are processed within 7 business days of receipt.
